english_translation: We bought maize meal, sugar, cooking oil, and vegetables.
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'Takatenga' establishes the noun class/subject frame (1st Person Plural Past Concord (taka-)).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'nemuriwo' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (ne- (associative/instrumental prefix) + -muriwo (stem)) with tone contour H-L-H-L.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).
